question: Where’s the closest gallery aligned with the route to Chicago Behavioral Hospital, Des Plaines, IL from Holiday Inn & Suites Joliet Southwest, Joliet, IL?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Holiday Inn & Suites Joliet Southwest%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Joliet%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Chicago Behavioral Hospital%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Des Plaines%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 500 -- Search within 500 meters of the straight-line route ) ORDER BY ST_Distance( geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Holiday Inn & Suites Joliet Southwest%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Joliet%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Chicago Behavioral Hospital%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Des Plaines%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography ) LIMIT 1;
